{{recipesummary|category=Bread recipes|servings=6|time=1 hour|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Native American cuisine|Native American cuisine]] 

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|corn meal]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]] (optional)
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* ½ cup plain [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], lightly [[Cookbook:Beat|beaten]]
* ¼ cup melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or olive oil

== Equipment ==
* [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]] (optional)
* 8-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] square [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]], greased
* [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]]
* [[Cookbook:Skewer|Toothpick]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat oven to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|425°F]] (220°C). If using a Dutch oven, preheat with 16–18 glowing charcoal briquettes, with 3 times as many on the top as on the bottom.
# In a large bowl, mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and brown sugar, if used.
# In another bowl, whisk together the milk, yogurt, egg, and melted butter or olive oil.
# Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and stir until just combined, no longer.
# Immediately pour into the greased pan and bake for 15–20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Over-mixing after adding together the liquid and dry mixtures will toughen the batter!
